sections.title: Recorded commitments
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,quote from commitments where meeting_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Reviewer observations
sections.sql: select topic,note,quote,reviewer from observations where meeting_id=$1 order by topic

name: coaching-note
title: Coaching review note
for_each: select id,title from meeting_review where review_state='Ready'

sections.title: Scoring evidence
sections.note: Human or agent-proposed reviews require operator checking. No automatic inference from audio.
sections.sql: select criterion,score,note,quote,reviewer from scores where meeting_id=$1 order by criterion

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.sql: select rule,issue from privacy_exceptions where id=$1
